policy: Preserve all source shells, existing panes, plinths, earlier fittings and courts. Retained OSM shop/food-service points bind only to their existing source owner and named street face. Lower shop glazing occupies a verified empty vertical band above the retained plinth and below earlier windows. Aperture position, size, blank fascia and trim are explicit display estimates, not a facade survey or a current-tenant claim. Native uses independently orthogonal blocks. Both families share NorthV185 batches, disposal and unchanged live limits.
preservation: All old packet/source bytes, pane positions, plinths, roofs, courts and descriptors retained.
limitations: OSM snapshot is 29 September 2026; no claim about today's tenants.
Small storefront openings and trim dimensions are estimates, not surveyed apertures.
Tor retains its 220 previously modelled shopfront panes; only outer trim is added.
Kastanienallee lacks earlier native pane spans; independent staircase blocks follow its retained source face.
